text:
Marie (CSM): Hey team — Acme Health returned the vendor questionnaire + a redlined DPA. Renewal signature requested by Friday EOD. Ticket: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/12345. Can someone from Security triage the DPA redlines? Key asks: data deletion clause change, subprocessors list, and restricted audit window. Thanks.

Devin (Security): Pulling it now. can you upload the redlined PDF to the secure bucket? don't post PHI in thread. s3 link or attach to the ticket.

Marie (CSM): Uploaded to ticket as private attachment. s3://redwood-secure/acme/dpa-redline-031025.pdf

Sam (Onboarding): FYI Acme's onboarding is paused pending DPA. They want SOC2 evidence and a signed DPA to enable prod access.

Devin (Security): Quick read: redline tightens deletion window to 30 days (we do 90). also wants on-site audit rights. propose counter: 60 days + remote audit + SOC2 report + attestations. tagging @Katie (Acct Exec) for commercial.

Katie (Acct Exec): renewal is at risk if we can't hit Friday. can we offer interim terms: SOC2 + signed DPA with a 60-day deletion compromise and an addendum for on-site audit subject to 30-day notice? they'd accept that?

Devin (Security): Yes — acceptable as initial compromise. Addendum for on-site only for customers on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted API customers, we restrict to remote audit + redacted logs. I'll draft language.

SecurityBot: Alert — Customer requested 'third-party subprocessor list' — PII list is in ops. Submit PR to /controls/subprocessors by 1752005600 to include Acme.

Marie (CSM): Thanks. Devin, can you paste a short email template for legal to send? I'll escalate with the customer.

Devin (Security): Draft below:

Hi [Legal/Acme contact],

Thanks for the redlines. We can accept a 60-day data deletion window and remote audit/attestation in lieu of on-site audits for Hosted accounts. For Dedicated/Private customers we can consider on-site with 30-day notice. Please confirm if this works and we'll route a final DPA for signature.

Best,
Redwood Security

Katie (Acct Exec): I'll offer a 30-day extension on the renewal deadline if they need time to review language. that should buy us breathing room.

Sam (Onboarding): Once we have signed DPA, I'll enable prod org and run a checklist. blocked items: 1) signed DPA 2) SOC2 report upload 3) account owner confirmation.

Marie (CSM): Noted. Next steps: Devin to upload draft DPA language to ticket by 1752005600, Katie to offer renewal extension, Sam to prep onboarding checklist. I'll ping again after Devin's post. :thumbsup:

Devin (Security): Draft uploaded to ticket and linked here: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/12345#draft. tagging legal for review.

Legal (bot): Document uploaded to Legal queue LG-672. Owner: legal-erin@redwood.ai

Marie (CSM): Great — closing loop. I'll update customer and set follow-up meeting for Thursday 10am PT. thanks everyone.

SecurityBot: Ticket 12345 status changed to 'In review' by legal-erin@redwood.ai
